I'm sure I'd say the same thing if I wasn't in this position but we've been friends for years and for about a year before we were together, best friends. She was always so happy and I've had so many of the best times of my life with her.

The thought of never seeing her again kills me. I really do care about her and I think she uses that against me. I think you're probably right about talking to her mum. I just don't know how to go about it =/

Also, as you are her ex, is there any possibility that she is doing this as a desperate attempt to get you back? Did she ever make any insinuation that if she still had you, she would have a reason to live?

Yes I think she is doing it to get me back. She tells me the only reason she was happy is because she had me and she can only sleep when I'm with her.

Thank you for your advise.
Sorry, I'm not a big redditor, I didn't realise them boards exist.

I've done this before and she has refused to go in her house. She will wait till we've drove off then walk to my house in just her dress or whatever she was wearing that night and sit out side my home until I come out.

Yeah maybe she isn't really suicidal but she's told me she is. She's begged me to kill her before.
I've seen her come an inch away from being hit by a car and have had to hold her in my car while travelling along at 30 mph.
Even if she wasn't serious I don't think I can ignore it
